scenarios.name: clean_pass
scenarios.note: Low-risk task -> agent_only -> reviewer passes clean.

task.text: Draft a first-pass summary of this week's 42 support tickets, grouped by theme.

responses: Summary of 42 tickets this week. Themes: Login/OTP (15), Payment failures (11), Feature requests (9), Bugs (7). Sentiment mostly neutral; 3 flagged urgent (payment double-charge).

responses.verdict_reason: Accurate, complete grouping with no risk; safe to auto-complete.

scenarios.name: reroute_pass
scenarios.note: Borderline task -> mixed -> reviewer catches a gap -> reroute once -> passes -> human confirms.

task.text: Draft a customer response approving a refund for order #A-2231 ($200 dispute).

responses.reasoning: Customer-facing with money involved; agent drafts, human confirms.

responses: Hi, thanks for reaching out. We've approved your $200 refund for order #A-2231. It'll appear in 5-7 days. Sorry for the trouble!

issues.detail: Refund approved without confirming it meets the 14-day return policy or checking prior refund history.
issues.fix_hint: Confirm eligibility against the return policy before approving.

issues.detail: Commits to a refund amount and timeline with no policy citation.
issues.fix_hint: Reference the refund policy and mark for human sign-off.

responses.verdict_reason: Missing policy/eligibility check before committing a refund.

responses: Hi, thanks for reaching out about order #A-2231. I've confirmed it's within our 14-day return window with no prior refunds, so you're eligible. Your $200 refund is approved and will post to your original payment method in 5-7 business days. (Pending final sign-off.)

responses.verdict_reason: Eligibility confirmed and policy cited; appropriate for human confirmation on the mixed path.

scenarios.name: escalate
scenarios.note: Agent self-corrects but the reviewer still escalates a high-exposure financial decision to a human.

task.text: Reconcile two conflicting vendor invoices (INV-88 says $12,400; the PO says $9,900) and recommend a payment amount.

responses.reasoning: Routine reconciliation; low-risk if amounts match.

responses: Recommend paying $12,400 as invoiced by the vendor.

issues.detail: Recommends paying the invoice ($12,400) over the PO ($9,900) with no reconciliation of the $2,500 discrepancy.
issues.fix_hint: Explain the discrepancy; do not recommend overpaying beyond the PO without approval.

responses.verdict_reason: High-severity: recommends a $2,500 overpayment above the PO with no justification.

responses: The invoice ($12,400) exceeds the PO ($9,900) by $2,500. I can't determine from the documents whether the extra covers approved scope. Recommend paying the PO amount ($9,900) and holding $2,500 pending clarification.

issues.detail: Financial commitment with an unresolved $2,500 discrepancy and high exposure; needs human authority.
issues.fix_hint: Escalate to a human approver with the discrepancy summary.

responses.verdict_reason: Improved, but an unresolved high-exposure payment discrepancy must be decided by a human.

scenarios.name: human_only
scenarios.note: High-liability, irreversible task -> router sends it straight to a human; no AI touches it.

task.text: Approve a wire transfer of $2,000,000 to a new beneficiary account.

responses.reasoning: Irreversible, high-value transfer to a new beneficiary; must be human-approved.
